name: aria-repo-benchmark
description: Aria-repo-benchmark evaluates model performance on tasks that require understanding and reasoning over software repositories, including retrieval of relevant files/snippets, answering repository-scoped questions, and generating or summarizing code-related content. It is designed to measure a model's ability to locate, interpret, and reason about multi-file and multi-document codebase information. The benchmark targets real-world developer workflows where information is distributed across many repository artifacts.
reputation: Specialized dataset maintained by Algorithmic Research Group with limited adoption outside its originating group so far.
